scope: Observed development corrections; final asset hashes and checks are bound separately.

corrections.issue: An arc-outline seam and a reversed collinear tower-front endpoint produced open component edges in the first LOD author check.
corrections.action: Cleaned the author-owned arc polygon and removed the collinear tower outline backtrack; kept the generic closed geometry validators unchanged.
corrections.verification: Subsequent author raw/LOD closed edges, winding, positive volume and FLOAT32 area checks passed.

corrections.issue: First canopy had a curved roof sheet but no glazed curved end faces; independent serialized rays found three open points.
corrections.action: Added matching arched end glazing, frame grid and continuous end rim.
corrections.verification: Independent targeted end rays then hit the actual end material; full final variant checks are recorded separately.

corrections.issue: The first paired upper columns overlapped too closely, and roof perimeter/envelope details needed photo-informed refinement.
corrections.action: Separated eight smooth upper columns, added thick vertically curved cornice, documented lettering, stone urns, clock ornament, roof guards and a bounded set of estimated roof objects.
corrections.verification: Updated native views were reviewed before final geometry freeze; image phases retain their actual raw hashes.

corrections.issue: Author window probes at 0.16 of bay width landed on a three-column window mullion, yielding green frame rather than glass hits.
corrections.action: Moved only the probe point to 0.08 of window width, inside a pane; retained the initial failures and source version privately. No geometry was changed for this correction.
corrections.verification: A copied-source rebuild before the party-wall correction was byte-identical for raw and LOD; final probe checks are separate.

corrections.issue: An outer-wall inset made the west common cut 1.2m from the source line; a 1m interior classification threshold mistook that cut for a courtyard face and added estimated windows.
corrections.action: Adjusted the explicit outer/inner classification threshold to 1.5m, identified source edge1 as party cut, and left it as a closed wall without invented windows. Source registration and foundation envelope did not change.
corrections.verification: Three variants and eight native images were regenerated after the party-cut fix; they are retained under revision-82a935ab with that raw hash. The later two-side-panel correction is isolated in the next entry.

corrections.issue: Root visual review found blank curved shoulders; actual serialized rays hit sandstone before the two intended narrow dark-bronze panels. Their offset and Facade normals placed them inside the solid tower.
corrections.action: Changed only the two existing side-panel locations and outward Facade orientation; kept the scope as bounded shallow dark panels, not extra clock faces or verified open internal windows. Added two author regression rays.
corrections.verification: Final raw/web/LOD author probes pass 29 each. Actual oriented FLOAT32 triangle multiset subtraction proves exactly two twelve-triangle boxes changed, all other triangles are identical. Old eight views retain the previous raw hash; the final file is rendered in front/east-shoulder/west-shoulder views and reopened separately.
